# Data Management and Sharing Plan

<!-- Retained for applications whose receipt date or NOFO still requires the
     2023 six-element format. Rename this file or update the active mechanism
     profile if it applies. Confirm the required format before submission. -->

## 1. Data Type

Describe the types, amount, and format of scientific data to be generated;
which data will be preserved and shared; and the relevant metadata.

## 2. Related Tools, Software and/or Code

State whether specialized tools are needed to access or analyze the data and
how those tools will be made available.

## 3. Standards

Name the data standards, formats, and metadata vocabularies that will make the
shared data interpretable and reusable.

## 4. Data Preservation, Access, and Associated Timelines

Identify repositories, persistent identifiers, the sharing timeline, and the
period for which the data will remain available.

## 5. Access, Distribution, or Reuse Considerations

Describe privacy, consent, legal, ethical, or technical limits on reuse and
justify controlled access where applicable.

## 6. Oversight of Data Management and Sharing

Name the responsible role and describe how compliance will be monitored during
the award.
